messages:
mia: Heads-up  saw a spike in SSE fanout drops for tenant=acme right after the quota window. Clients entered reconnect loops, console showed reconnect_count rising. Anyone else notice?
jon: saw it ~11:07 UTC. Route eu-west had fanout > configured limit and our per-route limiter started trimming. Lots of short reconnects.
priya: can you paste logs snippet?
mia: pasted minimal logs below:
```
2024-01-18T11:07:12Z route=eu-west fanout=128 tenant=acme action=trim reason=quota_exceeded limit=64 trimmed=64 reconnect=1
2024-01-18T11:07:13Z route=eu-west proxy=proxy-12 reconnect_attempt=2 err=EPIPE
```
jon: key issue: when we trim fanout we close sockets but still credit token usage for reconnects; billing and metrics get noisy. console shows routing policy=round_robin which fans to many backends.
oliver: product ask: console needs to surface "fanout trim" events with direct tenant links and a timeline so customers can correlate. Also propose a "soft trim" mode that reduces fanout instead of hard closes.
priya: SRE caveat: soft trim risks increased tail latency because we keep connections but degrade throughput. Suggest sequence: (1) pre-trim cache prefixes (reduce KV/KV-cache footprint), (2) soft-throttle new streams, (3) hard-drop if still overlimit.
mia: rough policy yaml idea:
```
fanout_policy:
  max_fanout_per_tenant: 64
  pretrim_cache: true
  soft_throttle_pct: 50
  soft_throttle_window_sec: 30
```
jon: add telemetry tags: fanout_action=trim|soft_trim, fanout_before, fanout_after, billing_annotation. Also alert when reconnects_per_tenant > 10/min.
oliver: UX: add a canary toggle in the rollout UI to "simulate fanout trim" for X% tenants so Solutions can test without impacting billing.
deploy-bot: canary:eng-platform/fanout-trim-sim v1 deployed to 10% at 11:32 UTC :rocket:
priya: billing question  if we intentionally drop sockets, do we refund or annotate? Current meters count reconnects. Ops wants either credits or a billing_exemption tag.
mia: agreed. Plan: add billing_adjust=fanout_trim tag in traces and downstream billing pipeline will subtract spike if tag present and policy matched.
jon: implementation note: kernel-level fanout counter must be decremented when we drop sockets, otherwise metrics overcount. There's a race where decrement happens after async metric flush. Need atomic ops.
mia: next steps: (1) add fanout_action tags to rho-telemetry (priya), (2) console: timeline + simulate toggle (jon + console), (3) implement policy + canary (mia), (4) add billing_adjust path (priya).
priya: i'll take telemetry + billing path.
jon: i'll own console bits and the rollout toggle.
mia: i'll coordinate canary rollout and write the playbook. Will include rollback criteria: reconnect_rate > 20/m or error_rate spike > 2x baseline.
oliver: i'll draft UX copy and notify Solutions & Support.
jon: ping @security about potential rate-limiter bypass if clients spoof tenant headers once we add soft-throttle.
mia: thanks all. I'll file the follow-up doc with the exact telemetry fields and playbook. :+1:
